notes.title: Meme Gameplay
notes.content: If you are still thinking about whether to buy or not, I advise you to get acquainted with the gameplay itself, not in the form of a trailer, but in the form of a loop broadcast.

notes.title: Meme Survivors 1.0
Meme Patch 1.1.5!
notes.content:
[b]Chimsy have never been this clever![/b]

Now they bypass obstacles and move toward the direction of the player's movement if they start falling too far behind. (Yes, the abuse of running in one direction is now much weaker, if that's even possible.)

Tu'um now resembles what everyone is used to, rather than just a circle that knocks enemies back.
Now it's three circles! But seriously, now Pop Cat, like in Skyrim, knocks back enemies in front of the player and deals damage.

Finally, you can see what the abilities and weapons do.
When leveling up, a "Book of Abilities" button appeared, which lists all abilities and weapons along with a brief description of their effects (and not just a gimmick like in the reward selection when leveling up).

[b]And a bunch of little details that aren’t even worth describing because only three and a half people will read this post :d

Enjoy the game, friends! <3

[b]Memes for the world![/b]

notes.title: Meme Survivors 0.1.1! Welcome to MacOS!
notes.content:
[b]Meme Survivors 0.1.1 is now on Steam![/b]

We're excited to announce that the game is now available not only on Windows but also on [b]MacOS[/b]!

What's new in this update:

[*] Fixed sound issues.

[*] Reworked enemy balance.

[*] Nerfed and buffed most weapons and abilities.

[*] Added and revamped weapon animations.

[*] Introduced animated backgrounds for the level-up and case opening menus.

[*] Added indicators for fish pickups and health recovery.

[*] Started work on porting to [b]mobile devices[/b].

[b]Meme world, friends![/b]
